title: Synthetic P0301 inspection sequence
steps: Confirm the synthetic fault code is present.
Inspect the synthetic ignition-coil electrical connection.
Inspect the synthetic spark-plug condition and connection.
Record observations without authorizing component replacement.
limitations: Requires verification by a qualified professional.

title: Synthetic P0420 inspection sequence
steps: Confirm the synthetic fault code is present.
Check the synthetic exhaust path for visible leakage indications.
Review synthetic upstream and downstream sensor patterns.
Check whether synthetic misfire codes remain unresolved.
Record observations without authorizing component replacement.
limitations: Requires verification by a qualified professional.
